name: InsightGinie: an ingest failure was recorded today
message: Review the private ingest status and last-good source snapshot. This is a cumulative daily count, not an error-rate calculation. Add the approved notification destination before activation.

name: InsightGinie: at least five Ask errors recorded today
message: Inspect categorized service failures. Do not attach prompts or request bodies. This monitor remains triggered while the current daily count exceeds the threshold; it is not an error-spike monitor.
